descriptions: Added a Menu Layout page to the Theme Editor — set up the menu your way with presets (Classic, Studio, Gallery, List), category position (inside, side list, or outside left/right), section order, card style, cards per row, size, title and subtitle.
Added an optional Now playing bar with a Stop button, and an optional section title with the animation count (both off by default).
Added font selection — pick a font for the whole menu or for one part, like just the header. 14 built-in fonts, and Default keeps the original look.
Added font importing from the editor (.ttf/.otf/.woff/.woff2, max 2 MB). All players see imported fonts right away with no restart. They're saved in the new fonts folder.
Added Config.NearbyPlayerDistance — sets how close players need to be to show up for group invites and Play Together (default 5.0 meters).
Custom weapon styles no longer apply in vehicles (cars, bikes, etc). Your style comes back when you get out.
The menu no longer loads a font from Google, so it opens faster the first time.
Side list: the hover icon no longer disappears, there's no empty space under the categories, and it has a cleaner look.
When updating: keep your config.lua, editor_overrides.json, theme.json and fonts folder.
Optional: add Config.NearbyPlayerDistance = 5.0 to your config.lua to change the distance. Without it, it stays at 5.0.
Edited the locales? Add NOW_PLAYING, STOP_EMOTE, GRID_VIEW and LIST_VIEW.
